labels.contract: REAL staged terms of the White Rock option (Elko County, NV, 2020; catalogue row NV-04): $10,000 at signing, then $25,000, $40,000, $50,000 and $125,000 at years 1-4, no work commitments, 2% NSR, $25,000 annual advance minimum royalty after exercise. Applied HYPOTHETICALLY to a 640-acre claim block inside the Tok Site B window; no such offer exists.
labels.carry: Alaska state claim rent assumed at $100 per 40 acres per year (2000 statute; current CPI-revised rate UNVERIFIED) = $1,600/yr; after exercise the $25,000/yr advance royalty is added.
labels.arrival: Staking events = distinct owner-days in the Tok Site B window, 2007-2025, from Alaska DNR state claims (NTPSTDT meaning unconfirmed). 2025 is partial: data end 2025-03-05, so its exposure is 63/365 of a year. The belief forgets old years at a rate chosen by one-step-ahead predictive score (only earlier years), averaged over the grid by those scores. Weak starting prior Gamma(0.5, 0.5 years). q (buyers per staking event) is an ASSUMPTION; the engine reports the q at which the decision flips.
labels.bids: ASSUMED two-point buyer offers for the full block. For scale only: published Alaska claim packages sold for about $170-205/acre (Avidian 2024; US Antimony 2025, an antimony option), i.e. roughly $109k-131k for 640 acres. Not a Tok price.
labels.acceleration: ASSUMPTION: the optionee may pay the remaining stages early to complete a sale when a buyer arrives. Not stated in the White Rock release; the engine reports the value with this assumption reversed.
